series.archiveLabel: India / UAE / Copenhagen / Spring / Print Archive
series.projectInformation: White Distance follows monuments and shorelines as weather strips them to outline. The images move from city scale to a single figure, then end where black sand meets white water.
series.roomStatement: Familiar landmarks turn uncertain in haze, glare, and distance. What remains is proportion: skyline, statue, body, horizon.

series.projectInformation: Red changes meaning as it moves—from shrine to storefront, blossom to hillside, umbrella to clothing. The final color keeps returning in public and private forms.
